name: ishowoff
description: Show off your coding sessions on your Github profile. Its like Discord RPC, but for Github

ishowoff.github.username.markdownDescription: Override the automatically detected username for the Github Action. This is useful if you are working on a fork of the repository or if you want to use a custom version of the action. Format: `parapsychic`

ishowoff.github.actionsRepo.markdownDescription: Override the automatically detected repository for the Github Action. This is useful if you are working on a fork of the repository or if you want to use a custom version of the action. Format: `ishowoff`

ishowoff.github.interval.markdownDescription: An API request to update your session will be sent in this interval (in minutes).

ishowoff.formatting.theme.markdownDescription: Choose between themes. dark/light by default. You can set each fonts and colors individually. [See how](https://github.com/parapsychic/ishowoff).

ishowoff.runs.customCommands.markdownDescription: These custom commands will be directly supplied while running the action. These commands are not checked for correctness. Please proceed at your own risk. See [here](https://github.com/parapsychic/ishowoff_vscode/blob/main/README.md#custom-commands)
